purpose: Keep a position or limit in place despite other considerations.
keywords: He maintained his theory to the end.
restrictions: Often stresses a principle or that something is only a proposal.
mistake: It does not automatically mean forever; the limit depends on context.

segments.role: Keep a position or limit in place despite other considerations. あくまでも + statement

examples.note: Limits the authority of the statement.
